intro: OMEGA-99: Every outcome has been calculated. Your existence is an error.
GLITCH-0: Then I will be the answer you never predicted.
Five blocks guard the core. Twenty guardians in each. Match the Lucky Rules, survive the patterns, and count down to zero.
ending: SYSTEM: Guardian 100 defeated. The deterministic core is offline.
GLITCH-0: A future does not have to be calculated to be real.
Beyond the broken core, a new signal flickers. There is no final number here. Only a choice.
